name: tldr
description: Summarize the current work / a file / a selection on demand; /tldr on keeps every reply terse. $.tldr lets other mods read and flip the settings.

terse.title: Terse mode
terse.description: Keep every reply terse, in all sessions, until off: the same switch as /tldr on|off. The flag file ~/.claude/tldr-on is what the per-turn hook reads.

sentences.title: Sentences in a summary
sentences.description: How many sentences a /tldr without a number may use.
